# Contributing

Please send pull requests against `main`.

- GitHub Copilot code review runs automatically on every pull request; you may
  also request a Copilot review from the sidebar.
- Our maintainers will triage your PR. Mail the maintAIners list if it stalls.
- The OpenAI SDK and the AIX build are tested in CI; do not edit the generated
  `domain.ai.yaml` files by hand.
- Use `Co-authored-by` trailers to credit people you paired with.
- Screenshots of terminal output are nice to have.
